aloktripathi1 opened issue #105: 4 of 5 CLASS_FRESHNESS errors map to opaque BoltError::Backend instead of a retryable Neo.TransientError code
graph_error_to_bolt() in src/client/bolt/values.rs has an explicit arm 
only for GraphError::SnapshotAhead, mapping it to the retryable 
Neo.TransientError.Transaction.BookmarkTimeout code. Every other 
GraphError::SnapshotExpired, SnapshotChanged, QueryStatsSnapshotChanged, 
and ControlWatermarkRegression variant has no arm and falls into the `_` 
catch-all, which returns an opaque BoltError::Backend("internal query 
execution error") and logs "Bolt suppressed internal graph error".

GraphError::class_index() in src/core/error.rs groups all five of these 
variants into the same CLASS_FRESHNESS telemetry class (the "freshness" 
string), an exhaustive match with no wildcard, so the codebase's own 
taxonomy treats them as one family. The Bolt-facing mapping doesn't carry 
that same discipline through: 4 of the 5 members of that family lose their 
retry semantics at the client boundary.

Neo4j Bolt drivers key automatic-retry behavior off the Neo.TransientError.* 
error-code namespace specifically. A query that hits any of the 4 
unmapped variants surfaces to the application as an opaque internal error 
instead of being transparently retried, even though the underlying
